headline: Xenon Logistics appoints new regional sales director
body: Xenon Logistics announced a leadership appointment in its sales organization. The company said the change is part of a planned succession.

headline: Xenon Logistics reports minor shipment delays at Leipzig plant
body: Xenon Logistics confirmed shipment delays of several days at its Leipzig plant due to a equipment maintenance backlog. The company said deliveries should normalize within weeks.

headline: Xenon Logistics signs multi-year framework agreement
body: Xenon Logistics announced a framework agreement with a large manufacturer. Terms were not disclosed, and the company expects stable volumes through the contract period.

body: Xenon Logistics announced a leadership appointment in its sales organization. The company said the change is part of a planned succession.

headline: Xenon Logistics faces customer complaints over packaging defects
body: Several customers reported damaged goods linked to packaging changes at Xenon Logistics. The company said it is reviewing its packing process.

headline: Xenon Logistics under fraud investigation over inflated invoices
body: Prosecutors are investigating Xenon Logistics over allegations of inflated invoicing to customers. The company denies wrongdoing, but two customers have paused orders.

headline: Lenders flag covenant breach at Xenon Logistics, bankruptcy rumors grow
body: Lenders to Xenon Logistics have flagged a covenant breach and are negotiating a standstill. Market commentary has raised the possibility of insolvency proceedings.

headline: Xenon Logistics reports record quarterly revenue
body: Xenon Logistics reported revenue growth of 8% year over year, driven by repeat orders. Analysts described the results as ahead of expectations.
